[[File:TestRange Default.jpg|thumb|Practice Range loading screen]]
The '''Practice Range''' is a special [[Arenas|Arena]] in THE FINALS where contestants can test out different [[Builds]], [[Weapons]], [[Gadgets]], and [[Specializations]] in a closed space. It features various environments, structures, dummies, and training facilities. Contestants can swap their build and loadout at any point by using one of several terminals in the arena.

It is a reworked version of [[Las Vegas]] that transforms the original into a championship stadium, with a focus on improved movement, cleaner sightlines, and smoother combat flow.
